arguments.command:
python3 -c "
# Data for matured noninterest-bearing debt (in millions)
data = {
    1960: 280,
    1961: 240,
    1962: 211,
    1963: 157,
    1964: 139,
    1965: 110,
    1966: 95,
    1967: 88
}

alpha = 0.4

# Initialize S_1960 with the first observation
s = data[1960]
print(f'S_{1960} = {s}')

# Calculate smoothed values for each year
for year in range(1961, 1968):
    s = alpha * data[year] + (1 - alpha) * s
    print(f'S_{year} = {s}')

print(f'\\nForecast for 1968 (S_1967 rounded): {round(s, 2)}')
"
